versions.changelog:
rdr2-playthrough 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for maintaining personal Red Dead Redemption 2 playthrough notes.
- Supports logging acquisitions, answering in-game location/crafting questions, and reviewing notes for duplicates or stale info.
- Enforces a concise, fact-checked, user-approved workflow for editing notes.
- Includes detailed rules for section structure, status markers, fact verification, and output formatting.
- No confidential data handling required; for personal use only.
